tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search Brick NJ Local (1006 listings). All filters optional. place = town, city, neighbourhood or state as written ('Point Pleasant Beach', 'Austin, TX'). category = a name from list_categories. near_lat/near_lng sort by distance within radius_km.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full listing for one business by the id search_businesses returned: hours, phone, address, prices, classes, amenities, offers, the business's own services and prices when it publishes them here, and what can be done through this directory (book, message).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category in this directory with how many listings each has.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Towns, areas, cities or states covered, with listing counts. Filter by state or by part of a name.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Open times for a business that has can_book, read live from its calendar. start_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and days (1-30) narrow the range. Times are ISO 8601 in the business's time zone; pass one back unchanged to book_appointment.

tools.name: contact_business
tools.description: Send a question, quote request or callback request to a business that has can_contact (kinds it takes are in get_business). The business gets the message and the person's name, email and phone (phone required for callbacks) and replies to them directly. Confirm the message and details with the perso

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a time from check_availability for the person you are helping. First confirm the business, the time, their name, email and mobile number with them, then call with confirmed=true. The business receives the booking on its calendar and the person's contact details for this booking only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business · Private data: contact_business, book_appointment · Public sink: contact_business, book_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business · Private data: contact_business, book_appointment · Public sink: contact_business, book_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
